name: labs/holtzmanjon__apoalpyca
title: APO 1m Ash Dome rotation (ASCOM Alpaca dome server)
intro: APO 1m Ash Dome rotation (ASCOM Alpaca dome server), adapted from holtzmanjon/apoalpyca. It reads `azimuth`, `shutterstatus`, `slewing`, `athome` and 1 more; runs `slew_azimuth`, `park`, `find_home`, `set_park` and 1 more. `slew_azimuth`: start a SlewToAzimuth and wait until the server reports slewing (relay on). Completion is a started rotation, not arrival; no start within 1.5 s is unknown. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
